body:
Hello everyone! I have created a wordsearch, and I hope that you all have fun doing it!

I will probably be doing these weekly, since it's good fun for the community, and you might learn some new "Avicus terms"!

The theme this week is Avicus Players.

Unfortunately, the numbers were cut off of certain players' names (if their name contained numbers).

Also, if you guys want to suggest a theme, feel free to do so!
